programme.title: Devi
programme.desc: Krishna (Prabhdheva) lives in Mumbai and dreams of marrying a modern girl but is eventually forced by his family to enter into wedlock with Devi (Tamannaah), a timid girl from his village. When the couple rent a new house in Mumbai, Devi gradually exhibits ghostly behaviours that terrify Krishna. The rest of the plot revolves around how Krishna get rids of the ghost that possessed Devi.

programme.title: Kamana
programme.desc: A modest woman finds herself stuck in a cycle of sex, drugs, and indecent proposals...but she finds potential for real love in her boss.

programme.title: Minmini
programme.desc: Praveena and Sabari, childhood acquaintances, reunite as adults on a Royal Enfield ride to the Himalayas. While Praveena cherishes each moment of the journey, Sabari is solely focused on the destination. Their contrasting perspectives create tension as they travel together. What happens when their paths cross again, and will they find common ground?

programme.title: Aulad
programme.desc: A married couple Anand and Devki gets acquainted with another newly married duo Yashoda and Vikas in Kashmir. Years later, they meet under tragic circumstances when their trains collide and the mishap claims Vikas's life. Believing his wife to be dead, Anand gives up his own child to Yashoda, who's given birth to a still-born. But Anand faces a dilemma when Devki returns.

programme.title: The Legend of Bhagat Singh
programme.desc: During the British Raj, upon witnessing the atrocities of the British, Bhagat Singh grows up to be a fierce freedom fighter. His publicised ideas of revolution bring him to as much popularity as Mahatma Gandhi amongst Indians.

programme.title: Asli Naqli
programme.desc: Anand (Dev Anand) is a spendthrift grandson of a rich businessman Rai Bahadur (Nazir Hussain) who wants him to marry Rekha (Indira), the only daughter and the heiress of a rich man, despite Anand's disinterest in her. In the ensuing fight, Anand leaves his house to prove his worthiness and ends up on the streets of Mumbai. Homeless and in need of work, he meets a young woman named Renu (Sadhana Shivdasani) and falls in love with her. But Renu is hiding a secret of her own.

programme.title: Ranam
programme.desc: A getaway driver trapped in crime follows his code to protect his only friend. Meeting someone who offers hope for change, he longs for redemption

programme.title: Vithi Mathi Ulta
programme.desc: Adithya (Rameez), a carefree youngster, experiences a worst nightmare when he's asleep. To make things more terrifying, the events in the dream begin to happen in real life too when he wakes up.

programme.title: Aag Ke Sholay
programme.desc: A man learns that his parents have been killed by their village's corrupt leaders. He resolves to seek revenge and bring their murderers to justice.

programme.desc: Siddharth (Jiiva) is a happy-go-lucky hacker who leads a peaceful family life. However, his life takes an unexpected turn when another hacker (Govind Padmasoorya) enters his world.

programme.title: Satchi Perumal
programme.desc: In registry offices, witnesses regularly sign deeds.this is the story of one such man. When a problem arises in his family, he must navigate challenges to find a resolution.

programme.title: Nandhi Varman
programme.desc: A thousand years ago, Gora and his men arrived in Anumanthapuram, part of Pallava king Nandivarman's domain, to loot the temple's gold treasure

programme.title: Raja
programme.desc: Two brothers agree to get their younger sister, Madhu (Madhuri Dixit) married to Raja (Sanjay Khan), the younger brother of a rich family friend Brijnath (Paresh Rawal) when the two of them come of age. Unfortunately, Brijnath loses all his riches in a blink of an eye when a massive fire breaks out in his factory. Upon learning Brijnath's present financial condition, Madhu's brothers sever all ties with Brijnath and his brother.

programme.title: KITNE DOOR
programme.desc: Two strangers, set to marry the partners chosen by their respective parents, meet on a plane to India and find themselves attracted to each other.

programme.title: Aakanksha
programme.desc: A father is determined to give his sons great futures, but his terrifying and corrupt methods may instead lead them to their demise.

programme.title: Anbanavan Asarathavan Adangathavan
programme.desc: A local gangster from Madurai who had left his dark past behind, finds himself falling in love with a younger girl during his fifties, which changes his life.

programme.title: Panjumittai
programme.desc: When Appu (Ma Ka Pa) ties the knot with Ranji (Nikhil) and leads a happy life, their marriage gradually begins to disintegrate as the former starts suspecting an affair between his wife and his longtime friend from childhood Kuppu(Sendrayan).

programme.title: House
programme.desc: A mounted fish moves, household objects levitate, and monsters haunt a troubled novelist (William Katt).

programme.title: Night of the Demons
programme.desc: Wild teenage girls (Mimi Kinkade, Linnea Quigley) hold a Halloween seance in an old funeral parlor to scare their friends.

programme.title: Night of the Living Dead
programme.desc: They won't stay dead! They keep coming back in a bloodthirsty lust for human flesh! Pits the dead against the living in a struggle for survival!

programme.title: Hush
programme.desc: A deaf woman is stalked by a killer in her home.

programme.title: Jeffrey
programme.desc: Jeffrey (Steven Weber), a gay man living in New York City with an overwhelming fear of contracting AIDS, concludes that being celibate is the only option to protect himself. As fate would have it, shortly after his declaration of a sex-free existence, he meets the handsome Steve Howard (Michael T. Weiss), his dream man -- except for his HIV-positive status. Facing this dilemma, Jeffrey turns to his best friend (Patrick Stewart) and an outrageous priest (Nathan Lane) for guidance.

programme.title: Take Me Home Tonight
programme.desc: Recent MIT grad Matt Franklin (Topher Grace) should be well on his way to a successful career at a Fortune 500 company, but instead, he rebels against maturity by taking a job at a video store. Matt rethinks his position when his unrequited high-school crush, Tori (Teresa Palmer), walks in and invites him to an end-of-summer party. With the help of his twin sister (Anna Faris) and his best friend (Dan Fogler), Matt hatches a plan to change the course of his life.

programme.title: Sliding Doors
programme.desc: When Helen (Gwyneth Paltrow), a London ad executive, is fired from her job and rushes out to catch a train, two scenarios take place. In one, she gets on the train and comes home to find her boyfriend, Gerry (John Lynch), in bed with another woman. In the second, she misses the train and arrives after the woman has left. In the first scenario, Helen dumps Gerry, finds a new man and gradually improves her life. In the second, she becomes suspicious of Gerry's fidelity and grows miserable.

programme.title: The Rebound
programme.desc: A newly single woman (Catherine Zeta-Jones) becomes involved with the much-younger man (Justin Bartha) she hired to take care of her children.

programme.title: Going All the Way
programme.desc: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war.

programme.title: A Walk to Remember
programme.desc: Set in North Carolina, "A Walk To Remember" follows the rite of passage of a jaded, aimless high school senior (Shane West) who falls in love with a guileless young woman (Mandy Moore) he and his friends once scorned. The two develop a powerful and inspirational relationship in which they discover truths that take most people a lifetime to learn.

programme.title: America's Black Forum
programme.desc: Political analyst Marc Morial hosts a weekly syndicated newsmagazine series featuring in-depth and engaging interviews with newsmakers, influencers, business entrepreneurs, artists, health and wellness experts and social justice leaders. Targeted to an African American audience, "America's Black Forum" was an hourlong production from 1977 to 2006. It has been revived as a 30-minute series after being off the air for 15 years, but has maintained the same format.

They decide to revamp their workshop team, update some of Pastor Frank's old messages, and host a city-wide fellowship and fundraiser. Will it be enough to save their struggling ministry?

Although Anthony is now single, he struggles with how to build a new relationship with a beautiful woman named Tiffany. Anthony is uneasy to love another and he pushes her away. He then finds a letter from his deceased wife, saying that if something happens to her, to love and marry again.

After years of dead end auditions and exploitation in music videos, she finally gets the break of a lifetime. But can she maintain the balance between the greedy Hollywood demands of being a rising young star with the indebtedness she feels to her often-unscrupulous family and the seedy Atlanta strip club where she was discovered?

programme.title: Beautifully Insecure

By her early 20's her insecurities had such a grip on her heart that she became a master of hiding her hair loss. It wasn't until she met Terrence, the love of her life, that she felt she couldn't hide it any longer. As their love grew, the pressure to tell Terrence about her hair loss did also.

Jessie soon finds herself living lavishly with Kara's wealthy grandparents, while Kara starts to bond with Jessie's fun, quirky grandmother and the most genuine, modest family that she's ever known.

He wants to be involved in her life, she wants her own space.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is called out to Hartford, CT to Elks Lodge, the oldest and largest secret fraternal organizations in the country. Elks Lodge #19 is shrouded in mystery and tragedy with a gruesome death hanging over its head....and decades of paranormal activity. Next they head to Morse Mill Hotel, in Morse Mill, Missouri - a hotel with a violent past. They are called in to help a client who is dealing with threatening spirits that emerged as renovations began.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Ohio to investigate Kings Island, an amusement park that sits on land that was the site of an awful accident. The workers here believe the people who died in the accident could be the ones still visiting the park. Some of the reported activity includes the sound of laughter, footsteps, objects being thrown, and a girl in a little blue dress who is said to be the ghost of a child buried in the nearby cemetery.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Naples, New York, to investigate the Naples Hotel. This hotel was built in 1895. There was a suicide at the hotel in the 1920's, which is when the activity is said to begin. The owners believe the ghost of the victim is still there and have nicknamed him "Topper." Some of the reported activity includes apparitions, voices, and objects being thrown.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS investigates a 19th century Bed and Breakfast in Red Boiling Springs, Tennessee, built by the Cloyd family. Over the years, many members of the Cloyd family passed away at this property. The current owners, the Coles, believe the Cloyds never left and are haunting the hotel. People have seen several full body apparitions, matching the descriptions of various Cloyd members. Whistling has been heard, a lady in pink has been seen as well as a man in black.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Wythe County, Virginia to answer a call for help at one of the town's most feared houses - The Graham Mansion. This foreboding, twenty-five room home has witnessed a twisted history of evil through the centuries starting with a slave owner in the 1700's who was murdered by his two slaves. In the 1800's, Squire David Graham purchased the home. His wife suffered from mental illness and was locked-up in the basement.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS, minus Grant, answers a call for help from Providence City Hall where paranormal activity is threatening the staff. And now there is also concern for the hundreds of citizens who pass through this building every day. Built in 1878, this prominent building has the city's history tucked away between its walls, including a ghostly former mayor who is refusing to leave office...even when on the other side.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Grant's final case draws near, but that doesn't stop the TAPS team from helping those in need. They head to Mount Joy, Pennsylvania to investigate Bube's Brewery to see if the late owner, Alois Bube, and his deceased family members are still presiding over the lager business. Alois purchased the brewery in 1876 and added on a Victorian hotel to serve his beer and accommodate overnight guests.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Grant's last show draws even closer, but in the meantime the cases keep coming, and this one is very exciting for the whole team; the USS Yorktown in Mt. Pleasant, South Carolina. This is an 872-foot warship, which served in WWII as well as Vietnam and also recovered the Apollo 8 astronauts and space capsule. The USS Yorktown has carried thousands of men and lost more than 140 of them while in battle. Most were pilots who never returned from their missions.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: As Grant's final show is now just a case away, the team revisits an old favorite of his, Mt. Washington in Bretton Woods, New Hampshire. Not only was this the resort Grant honeymooned at 15 years ago but it later became a location that provided incredible evidence for the team. Now there are new claims and more areas and rooms open to the TAPS team.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For Grant's last episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team decides to stay close to home and investigate Jason and Grant's very own Spalding Inn. GHI investigated their Inn before, but this will be TAPS' first opportunity. The Spalding Inn was originally a summer home named Cherry Hill House that began taking in guests in 1865. It was renamed the Spalding Inn in 1926 when Randall and Anna Spalding took over.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to South Carolina, the winner of America's Hometown Ghost Hunters Contest, to investigate the renowned Old City Jail. This historical Jail was the final destination of America's first female serial killer, Lavinia Fisher. It's believed that Lavinia still lingers in the prison and it is up to TAPS to determine if that's true. This site has been around since 1738, when it was first used as a workhouse for slaves and a makeshift hospital for paupers, vagrants, and beggars.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Rutledge, Georgia to investigate Camp Rutledge, a family friendly camp, that is anything but friendly at night. The call to help comes from a frightened mother, Melissa, who has attended the camp since she was 17 yrs, and now has a daughter old enough to start vacationing at the campsite. Melissa has witnessed many unexplained paranormal things, and wants to make sure it's safe before she takes her daughter there.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads out on their first case since co-founder Grant Wilson left. This case takes them to New Orleans, Louisiana to investigate what's locally known as the Upstairs Fire at Jimani Lounge. The current owner, Jimmy Jr. was only 12 years old when an arsonist set fire to his father's club on June 24th, 1973. 32 men died trying to escape, but because these men were associated with the gay community, many bodies were never claimed, therefore, victims were never identified. Jimmy Jr.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is asked to investigate Fort Ontario, a place that was the only location in America to provide sanctuary for Jewish refugees during World War II. Built in 1755, this fort first saw battle during the French and Indian war, and is no stranger to bloodshed. ...and phenomena.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Baton Rouge, Louisiana to investigate the Old State Capital Building. Built in 1852, this building has seen countless politicians come through its doors including congressman, Pierre Couvillon, who died during a heated debate opposing gambling. The building also survived the Civil War, during which the Union Army used the basement as a prison.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Joliet, Illinois to investigate that Rialto Square Theater. In the 1920's the Rialto Square Theater hosted famous entertainers and vaudeville stars. But in the 1930's an accident took place right outside the theater where a little boy was hit by a car and then later dies inside. People in the theater have since claimed to see the little boy, who they named Kevin, and experienced other eerie paranormal activity.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Claremont, New Hampshire to investigate a former shoe and furniture factory, the Topstone Mill. What was once an abandoned space has now become a restaurant and bar... with frequent visitors from "the other side." Could deceased workers from the 1900's be trying to contact a mother and son team who own the bar? TAPS has surprising evidence that could point in that direction.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Hampton Falls, New Hampshire to investigate the Governor's Mansion, a property Steve has investigated before with a local team. Could this estate's hauntings be connected to a sad secret surrounding a little boy who is believed to have once lived here in the late 1800's? Will TAPS be able to reach this child and find out if he was in fact the hidden legitimate son of State Senator, Warren Brown? Could the State Senator have been behind his murder?

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Gloucester, Massachusetts to investigate Hammond Castle. They are joined by Josh Gates to find out if the original owners and paranormal pioneers, John and Irene Hammond haunt their property. Are the Hammonds able to talk to the living, as they once were able to do with the dead? What does a disembodied voice say that leads TAPS to believe the Hammonds might still be here?

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Bowling Green, Kentucky to investigate Western Kentucky University. This University was established in 1906 and has 20,000 students attending. Tamela Smith is the client, and has called TAPS in to figure out if some of the stories that have been passed down over the decades are folklore or truth. There are three main stories that surround the school.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Rochester, New York to investigate the Rochester Public Library's 15 years of claims. There's reason to believe that two deaths associated with the building could be behind the activity. The library wants to go public with the phenomena but only if accurate. Can TAPS find the answer they are looking for and finally let the public in on this library's long-held secret?

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Hollywood, California to investigate the infamous Black Dahlia murder at the historic Sowden House. Aspiring actress, Elizabeth Short was nicknamed the Black Dahlia after her brutal murder and the leading suspect of that horrific crime was never convicted. Two people have called in TAPS; the first being the main murder suspects own son, Steve Hodel.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to San Juan Capistrano, California to investigate the San Juan Capistrano Mission. This mission has been in the community for 236 years dating back to the Spanish Colonial. An earthquake in 1812 buried 40 people in the rubble; including a teen age girl named Magdalena. The legend goes that she was dating a boy her father disapproved of, and had to do penance at the alter. As she walked up to confess, the earthquake began and she was buried alive.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Bartonville, Illinois, to investigate Peoria Asylum. The owners are renovating this building and have noticed a lot of paranormal activity since they started their restorations. Built in 1898 and opened in 1902, it is said that 16,000 people died there, from multiple reasons, including, patients killing patients and suicide. The asylum's records hold two key figures; Dr.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Louisville, Kentucky to investigate the oldest operating steamboat in the United States. The boat was built in 1914 and has been used for everything from dances to gambling. Its former Captain Winters was legendary for being somewhat shady. It's claimed that he killed a deckhand named Floyd during an argument when he sent him to do work on the paddle wheel and then ordered full steam ahead, which killed Floyd.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Coventry, Connecticut to investigate the Nathan Hale Homestead. Nathan Hale was an American Patriot who fought in the Revolutionary War and was executed by hanging by the British for being a spy. He was left outside hanging for days to send a message. He was then dumped in an unmarked grave. Now our client, Bev, believes he has come back to his childhood home. His house was built in 1776 and in the 1940's was turned into a museum.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Sylvan Beach Park in Sylvan Beach, New York to investigate a theme park originally built in the 1890's. Sylvan Beach Park used to be referred to as the Coney Island of Central New York, with its famous hotels, lakeside attractions, and amusement rides. Now Sylvan Beach holds a haunted history and TAPS has been asked to investigate, much to the unease of some of the employees who fear the investigation will agitate the spirits further.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Shreveport, Louisiana to investigate the Shreveport Auditorium, a place that is famous for introducing Elvis to the world. Shreveport Auditorium opened in 1929 and is considered a national landmark. The auditorium's stage has been graced by such stars as Hank Williams and Johnny Cash and is known as the first place Elvis preformed professionally. A statue of Elvis was erected after he passed and that's when the phenomena is said to have begun.
programme.sub-title: The Ghost Hasn't Left the Building

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is called to Liberty, Missouri to investigate the Belvoir Winery; a property that has four buildings that are being renovated to become a retirement facility and winery. These buildings were at one time an orphanage, an old folks home, a hospital, and a nursing home and have seen over 10,000 deaths through the years.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: In 1931, Boulder City was built to accommodate the thousands of Hoover Dam workers and their families who inundated the area. Around the same time, the Boulder City Hospital was constructed mainly to care for the injured and dying Hoover Dam workers. Because of dangerous working conditions and hardships, over 100 men died building the Dam, with many of them ending up at the Boulder City Hospital.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The Elms Resort & Spa in Excelsior Springs, Missouri was built in the 1880's to accommodate the thousands of visitors flocking to the area, which had rapidly gained a reputation of having mineral springs with magical healing powers. The first Elms Resort was opened in 1888 and burned down in 1898. They opened a new hotel in 1912 (which has recently been renovated).

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Monticello, Arkansas to investigate The Allen Mansion, built in 1906 by a wealthy businessman named Joe Allen. He lived there with his wife and three daughters. One of Joe Allen's daughters, Ladell is believed to have committed suicide in the mansion at the age of 54 years because of her divorce and later losing her son to pneumonia.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Scott Township, Pennsylvania to investigate the Pennsylvania Asylum and Testing Lab. This building was originally used as a poor house in the late 1800's and became a mental institution in 1915, followed by an animal testing facility. TAPS will have their hands full as they take on claims of threatening shadows and people being physically accosted.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Hyde Hall in Cooperstown, NY to investigate a cursed family home. George Clark started building Hyde Hall in 1817 with the intension of it being a showplace for Clarke's agricultural empire and to remind him of his childhood in England. George died in 1835 on the southern porch before completion and his son, George Jr., took over the property. This was followed by a contentious relationship between George Jr. and his mother.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: In 1863, the Battle of Gettysburg spanned 3 days and was the bloodiest conflict of the Civil War. 97,000 Union Soldiers and 75,000 Confederate Soldiers fought resulting in 51,000 casualties and one civilian fatality in a town that normally only has a population of 2,400. On the 150th Anniversary of the Battle, TAPS is called to Gettysburg, Pennsylvania, by one of Jason's good friends, Mark Nesbitt.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Octagon Hall was built by Andrew Jackson Caldwell in 1847. Andrew and his wife, Elizabeth helped Confederate Soldiers during the Civil War by setting up a hospital room, where many of the soldiers died. They also built tunnels and passageways where the Confederate Soldiers could hide from the Union Soldiers. Andrew's wife and son died of Typhoid Fever during the war and his daughter, Mary Elizabeth, died when her dress caught on fire in the kitchen and she burned to death.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS has been called to Lucas, Ohio by playwright Mark Jordan to investigate the property on which one of the most gruesome events took place in 1896, The Ceely Rose Murders. Ceely killed her father, brother and lastly, her mother with rat poison because she believed they were keeping her from the love of her life, Guy Berry. Ceely was 23 years at the time, but had a mental capacity of an 8 year old. Mark wrote a play about these murders, which he performs in a barn on the property.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Belle Grove Plantation sits in King George, Virginia. It is now a bed and breakfast, but the plantation played an important role in American History. James Madison, the 4th president, was born here, and John Wilkes Booth crossed through the property after he assassinated President Lincoln. The armed contingent searching for Booth stayed at Belle Grove Plantation the night before they caught and killed him.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS stays close to home as they investigate the Cumberland Library & Monastery in Cumberland, Rhode Island. A massacre that occurred in the spring of 1676 may have been the first of several events to cause the paranormal activity that exists today.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS investigates the abandoned Elizabeth V. Edwards Elementary School in Barnegat, New Jersey. Built in 1930, this was first Barnegat High School until a larger one was built in 1957, turning this into an elementary school. In 1975 the school was renamed Elizabeth V. Edwards. Elizabeth was someone who dedicated her entire life to the education of Barnegat's young people. She passed away in 1965. The school was shut down in 2004.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Client, Rebecca Jordan Gleason has called TAPS back to Trans-Allegheny Lunatic Asylum, in Weston, West Virginia, at a time when they are celebrating their 150th anniversary and Ghost Hunters, their 200th episode. TAPS was here in 2008 and found great evidence. Their parting words to Rebecca were for her to not do anything to stir up more paranormal activity...but that advice was not heeded and the activity has increased.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The prestigious Cincinnati Music Hall has welcomed famous composers and entertainers ranging from Igor Stravinsky and Richard Straus to Ella Fitzgerald and Bruce Springsteen. But it's the "the dead" that have shined a light on this historical building. In 1878 the central hall was first constructed and a year later the north and south halls were added to accommodate the industrial exhibitions that were so popular at the time.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS investigates five different locations along one of the most haunted streets in America! Main Street in St. Charles, Missouri was built on top of a cemetery, which at one time housed hundreds of bodies. As St. Charles grew, it became inconvenient to have a cemetery in the middle of the city and in 1850 it was decided that bodies should be moved to another area. However, not all of them were removed and buildings were constructed over them.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Joplin, Missouri to investigate the Holly Hill Estate. The property is comprised of two houses with very different histories. The first house is called Willow Vista, which was built in 1916 and was a private club with ties to the mob. Over the years it was also believed to have been a speakeasy and a brothel. In 1958, a doctor named Donald Patterson bought the Willa Vista and made it into a family home.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS stay close to home as they investigate two neighboring buildings: Stadium Theatre and Stadium Building in Woonsocket, Rhode Island. Original owner, Arthur Darman constructed the building and the theatre in 1926. His vision for the theatre was to bring live entertainment to those who couldn't afford to travel to New York. The adjacent building was a community hub, which featured doctors' offices, law firms, dentists, and insurance agencies.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Lawrenceburg, Kentucky to investigate The Wild Turkey Distillery. Guest investigator, Kristen Luman, as well as two familiar faces, Dustin and KJ join the team. The descendent of the founding family, Olivia Ripy, calls the team in to investigate. Her family started making whiskey as far back as 1869 and in 1935, her grandparents went into business as the Ripy Brothers.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS stays close to home on this investigation as they travel to Newport, Rhode Island to investigate Fort Adams, the largest coastal fortress ever constructed on US soil. This is the second fort built on the site. The original structure was built in 1799 and stood through 1812. The fort was rebuilt from 1824-1857 and could hold 468 cannons, where as the first could only hold 20. Many deaths were reported but had nothing to do with battle but rather, murder, suicide, and illness.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Bennington, Vermont to investigate Southern Vermont College. Edward Everett was a wealthy man who built his mansion on these grounds between 1911-1914. He was married twice and had 5 children. When he died in 1929 his estimated worth was between $40-$50 million. The legend that students have passed down through the years is that Edward's first wife, Amy, committed suicide, and didn't die of poor health, which was reported.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Louisville, Kentucky to investigate the Conrad-Caldwell Castle, the masterpiece built by well-known architect, Arthur Loomis. The house took 3 years to complete and was the symbol of success for the original owner, Theophilus Conrad and his wife, who started out as poor immigrants before working their way up to being wealthy industrialists. The couple lived in this home for ten years, before Mr. Conrad died of a heart attack on the basement stairs.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Lenox, Massachusetts to investigate The Mount, a location they first visited in 2008. Built in 1902, the Mount was designed and built for Pulitzer Prize winning author, Edith Wharton and her husband, Teddy. When their marriage started to fall apart in 1911, the couple moved out and eventually divorced. This renowned property is where Edith wrote many of her best sellers, and had famous friends visit, including Henry James.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to North Adams, Massachusetts to investigate Houghton Mansion. It was built in 1897 for North Adams' first Mayor, A.C Houghton. Constructed on the foundation of a previous home, The Houghton Mansion was used for the family and fundraisers. The hauntings are said to have begun in 1914 after a tragic car accident took the lives of A.C Houghton and his daughter. His chauffer was driving and was so overcome with guilt that he took his own life the next day. A week later Mr.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters

It was constructed in the early 1900's by Margaret, who was one of seven MacKenzie siblings to build a grand estate in Glen Spey with the money given to her by her father. Several of Charles and Margaret's children passed away young, and their coachman, William attempted suicide on the property, and later died.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ximena confiesa que no ama al Turco, que solo sintió agradecimiento por él. Después de matar a Ronnie, Aurelio encuentra a su exesposa, quien le dice que nunca volverá con él.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Luego de separarse tras el tiroteo, Aurelio y Ximena se reúnen con sus hijos. El Turco usa a Irina para averiguar el paradero de Casillas, y así poder negociar con él.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Matilde quiere aliarse con Chema para hacer un negocio a espaldas de Chacorta. Lay se mete a la tina con Aurelio y, luego de algunas confesiones, pasan una noche de pasión.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio visita a Mónica para amenazarla, pero ella recuerda el daño que él le hizo y se defiende. Más tarde, los hombres de Leonor se enfrentan a Chacorta y a Heriberto en una emboscada.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio le dice a Mónica que fingió su muerte para cobrar venganza a sus enemigos. Ximena se reencuentra con su hijo Heriberto, quien necesita de su ayuda para salir del mundo del narcotráfico.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio le tiende una trampa al Turco y lo amenaza, pero no recibe respuestas sobre el dinero. Después de mucho buscar a Leo, Ignacio Miravalle la encuentra y jura ayudarla a salir de la cárcel.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica sugiere que Aurelio negocie su propia mercancía y la divida con los colombianos. Doña Alba se interpone cuando la idea separa a los hermanos Casillas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Todos creen que Aurelio Casillas ha muerto en una sala de operaciones. Sin embargo, la muerte que tanto impactó al mundo del narco mexicano es, en realidad, una mentira de quien busca venganza.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio captura al Turco y lo tortura para descubrir dónde está el dinero que le robó. Mientras, el Chema Venegas, desconfiando de los Casillas, ordena a Tijeras secuestrar a doña Alba.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Se planean dos ataques durante la reunión entre el presidente mexicano y el director de la DEA de EE. UU. Luego de una injusta pelea, acusan a Leonor de matar a una prisionera.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica descubre que Aurelio viajará con Lay, y en un ataque de celos, amenaza con matarla. El Cabo busca la ayuda de Robles para viajar a Colombia, y le propone trabajar juntos.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Heriberto visita a Ignacio y le pide ayuda para salir del país. Mónica le dispara a Irina para evitar que huya de México. Chema quiere obtener ADN de Aurelio para compararlo con el del cadáver.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Heriberto le confiesa a Ximena que se va a Europa para salirse del mundo de la droga. Elsa elige lanzarse como candidata, en lugar de aceptar un puesto en el gabinete presidencial.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Leonor es llevada a juicio, y aunque Ignacio maneja su defensa, la condenan a 15 años. Mientras, Pedro busca el apoyo de Max y Elsa el de Chema durante la campaña para la gubernatura de Jalisco.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio toma al Cabo como rehén y viaja a Colombia, donde toma venganza matando a su hijo. Luego se interna con Mónica en la selva colombiana, él con el nombre de Francisco, ella como Dolores.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio cesa los envíos a Chacorta tras los ataques a las Torres Gemelas, y busca nuevas rutas para pasar la droga. Al campamento llega un infiltrado del Tostado, listo para hacer daño.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Leo se debate entre escapar con una compañera de prisión o quedarse y confiar en que Ignacio la libere por vías legales. Mónica le dice a Aurelio que quiere tener un hijo suyo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El general Montoya descubre la verdadera identidad de Francisco, y le pone precio a su silencio. Tras varios años de ausencia, Heriberto regresa a casa y Chacorta lo visita.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Chema quiere ir a Colombia para descubrir la identidad del mexicano que se está inmiscuyendo en su negocio, y Leonor busca la ayuda del coronel Ramos para liberar a Ponte de la cárcel.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ignacio ofrece casarse con Leonor para que no la deporten. Chacorta le ofrece a Matilde un trato que no puede rechazar. Aurelio amenaza a Gildardo con desmembrarlo si no dice la verdad.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.title: Spectre
programme.desc: A cryptic message from the past leads James Bond (Daniel Craig) to Mexico City and Rome, where he meets the beautiful widow (Monica Bellucci) of an infamous criminal. After infiltrating a secret meeting, 007 uncovers the existence of the sinister organization SPECTRE. Needing the help of the daughter of an old nemesis, he embarks on a mission to find her. As Bond ventures toward the heart of SPECTRE, he discovers a chilling connection between himself and the enemy (Christoph Waltz) he seeks.

programme.title: Olympus Has Fallen
programme.desc: The unthinkable happens when heavily armed and highly trained terrorists launch a bold daytime attack on the White House. The building is overrun, and President Benjamin Asher (Aaron Eckhart) and his staff are taken hostage. Luckily for Asher, former presidential security officer Mike Banning (Gerard Butler) is on the scene. With time running out, it's up to Banning to locate Asher's son before the extremists do and rescue the president before his captors unleash their ultimate plan.

programme.title: London Has Fallen
programme.desc: After the death of the British prime minister, the world's most powerful leaders gather in London to pay their respects. Without warning, terrorists unleash a devastating attack that leaves the city in chaos and ruins. Secret Service agent Mike Banning (Gerard Butler) springs into action to bring U.S. President Benjamin Asher (Aaron Eckhart) to safety. When Asher falls into the hands of the sinister organization, it's up to Banning to save his commander in chief from a horrible fate.

programme.desc: Detectives Erin Lindsay and Antonio Dawson from Chicago P.D. help SVU when two convicted murderers escape.

programme.desc: An online pedophile ring -- including two high-profile suspects -- is targeted in an undercover sting.

programme.title: Bones
programme.desc: When a psychic tries to help the spirit of a boy whose death the team is investigating, members of the team start to question their own feelings on life and death.

programme.title: NCIS

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: The murder of a petty officer in a small town outside D.C. prompts NCIS to once again work with The Sherlocks, a privately funded investigative team.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Bishop is determined to get revenge for the murder of her late boyfriend, Qasim, after Gibbs and the team find a new lead in the Chen case; Torres teaches the agents the art of pickpocketing.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: McGee finds his apartment torn apart by a robber trying to locate a valuable item hidden there by the convicted criminal who previously owned the unit; Congresswoman Flemming encourages Vance to pursue a career in politics.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: To carry out a sailor's dying wish, Gibbs and the NCIS team re-investigate a murder case that was originally ruled an accidental death.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: When a Marine is murdered at a charitable event, an irritable war veteran must help solve the crime; McGee and Bishop investigate an intriguing rumor about Quinn and Torres.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: A ransom-seeking hacker infiltrates a vice admiral's laptop and threatens to erase his personal and professional files; Alex takes time off to assist her mother.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Torres turns to old case notes and contacts after a Marine's murder becomes linked to a former dirt bike gang he joined for a year-long undercover operation.

programme.title: There Was a Crooked Man
programme.desc: After a botched heist, Wild West bandit Paris Pitman Jr. (Kirk Douglas) hides his newly stolen money where no one will find it, then loses his entire gang in a blaze of bullets before being captured by the law and given a lengthy sentence in a desert jail. Paris believes that he can buy his way out of his predicament by offering some cash to the guards, but the upstanding Sheriff Lopeman (Henry Fonda) makes sure his men remain honest. Running out of options, Paris begins plotting a jailbreak.

programme.title: Blood on the Moon
programme.desc: Down-and-out cowhand Jim Garry (Robert Mitchum) is asked by his old friend Tate Riling (Robert Preston) to help mediate a cattle dispute. When Garry arrives, however, it soon becomes clear that Riling has not been entirely forthright. Garry uncovers Riling's plot to dupe local rancher John Lufton (Tom Tully) out of a fortune. When Lufton's firecracker of a daughter, Amy (Barbara Bel Geddes), gets involved, Garry must choose between his old loyalties and what he knows to be right.

programme.title: Rio Diablo
programme.desc: Newlywed Benjamin Taber (Travis Tritt) is in town with his bride when a bank robbery goes awry and she disappears in a chaotic shootout. Determined to find her, Benjamin seeks out the help of crusty Quentin Leech (Kenny Rogers), a bounty hunter who has his own reasons for wanting to catch the outlaws. As they follow the group's trail, they receive help from several unlikely sources, including Flora Mae Pepper (Naomi Judd), the owner of a brothel that doubles as a safe haven.

programme.title: Annie Oakley
programme.desc: Annie relies on Tagg's ability as a ventriloquist to save an innocent stage driver from angry townspeople.

programme.title: Annie Oakley
programme.desc: Tagg (Jimmy Hawkins) and his friend Billy (Stuffy Singer) run away to a ghost town inhabited by an outlaw gang. With Gail Davis.

programme.title: Annie Oakley
programme.desc: Annie uses the town's new fire engine to capture some bank robbers who are hiding in a shack near town.

programme.title: Annie Oakley
programme.desc: Annie (Gail Davis) investigates when a young dance teacher has a seemingly ironclad alibi for a series of crimes. With Lou Smith, Sue Smith.

programme.title: Annie Oakley
programme.desc: A young doctor (David Alpert) faces a moral dilemma when asked to treat the escaped convict (Gregg Barton) who killed his father (Stanley Andrews).

programme.title: Annie Oakley
programme.desc: An injured rancher summons all his strength to help Annie and Lofty when outlaws hold his wife hostage.

programme.title: Hopalong Cassidy
programme.desc: Hopalong and his friends are sent to round up a bunch of wild horses for Col. Theodore Roosevelt and his Rough Riders.

programme.title: Hopalong Cassidy
programme.desc: Belle Starr has returned from time in prison only to face a hail of bullets, along with rescue by Hoppy and the Bar 20 gang.

programme.title: The Californians
programme.desc: Consumed with the fear of losing their illegitimate earnings, some corrupt San Francisco businessmen conspire to besmirch Matt Wayne's stellar reputation.

programme.title: The Californians
programme.desc: When a crew of alleged mutineers lands in trouble, the responsibility to defend them falls on the shoulders of Jeremy Pitt.

programme.title: Gun Glory
programme.desc: Life is anything but sweet when roaming gunfighter Tom Early (Stewart Granger) returns home. His wife has died, and his son (Steve Rowland) now barely speaks to him. Things aren't much different in town, where Early tangles with the posse of a cattle baron (James Gregory) who vows to run a herd of 20,000 roughshod through the settlers' land. Early must somewhat reluctantly play the role of defender, especially after a foolhardy plan by the local preacher (Chill Wills) goes awry.

programme.title: Tom Horn
programme.desc: A renowned gunslinger with a storied past, Tom Horn (Steve McQueen) opts for a reclusive life until he starts working for rancher John Coble (Richard Farnsworth). Though Horn begins seeing pretty local teacher Glendolene Kimmel (Linda Evans), he remains restless. Investigating livestock theft, Horn is brutal when dealing with criminals, and while his presence is initially appreciated, eventually the community grows concerned about the enforcer's violent methods.

programme.title: Death Rides a Horse
programme.desc: Having witnessed the brutal murder of his entire family by bandits at the age of 5, Bill Meceita (John Phillip Law) has spent 15 years planning his vengeance. Finding a kindred spirit in Ryan (Lee Van Cleef), an experienced gunslinger seeking his own revenge on those who framed him, the two team up to find and kill Walcott (Luigi Pistilli), a fearsome bandit on the loose. But Bill soon discovers that Ryan may know more about his tragic past than he has let on.

programme.title: A Fistful of Dollars
programme.desc: Wandering gunfighter Joe arrives in the Mexican village of San Miguel in the midst of a power struggle among sheriff John Baxter and the three Rojo brothers. When a regiment of Mexican soldiers bearing gold is waylaid by the Rojo brothers, Joe is hired by Esteban to join the gang, but he plays one side against the other.

programme.title: For a Few Dollars More
programme.desc: In the Wild West, a murderous outlaw known as El Indio (Gian Maria Volonte) and his gang are terrorizing and robbing the citizens of the region. With a bounty on El Indio's head, two bounty hunters, Monco (Clint Eastwood) and Col. Douglas Mortimer (Lee Van Cleef), come to collect the prize. Upon their first meeting, the two men view each other as rivals, but they eventually agree to become partners in their mutual pursuit of the vicious criminal.

programme.title: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly
programme.desc: In the Southwest during the Civil War, a mysterious stranger, Joe (Clint Eastwood), and a Mexican outlaw, Tuco (Eli Wallach), form an uneasy partnership -- Joe turns in the bandit for the reward money, then rescues him just as he is being hanged. When Joe's shot at the noose goes awry during one escapade, a furious Tuco tries to have him murdered. The men re-team abruptly, however, to beat out a sadistic criminal and the Union army and find $20,000 that a soldier has buried in the desert.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: An Argentine family moves to North Fork and settles on a ranch adjoining Lucas'.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas and Mark find themselves exposed to anthrax when they adopt a horse.

programme.title: The Gene Autry Show
programme.desc: A portrait painter plans crimes while sketching his models, who are chosen to help the artist gain financial reward.

programme.title: The Gene Autry Show
programme.desc: While trying to help a minister rid a town of crooked politicians and gamblers, Gene and Pat are accused of murder.

programme.title: The Gene Autry Show
programme.desc: To save the new school, Gene bets the ranch on a chariot race.

programme.title: The Gene Autry Show
programme.desc: Gene Autry and Capt. Fernando investigate American gunrunners providing Winchester repeaters to Mexican renegades.

programme.title: Apache
programme.desc: Adapted from the 1936 novel Bronco Apache, this groundbreaking Western casts a sympathetic eye on the struggles of Native Americans in the post-bellum West. Massai (Burt Lancaster), the only Apache warrior still fighting after the surrender of Geronimo, is arrested and placed on a train headed for a Florida prison. After a daring escape, he begins the trip back home to his lover, Nalinle (Jean Peters), on foot -- but the journey is long and treacherous, and the authorities are closing in.

programme.title: The Gene Autry Show
programme.desc: Postal inspectors attempting to close down a lonely hearts club racket accuse Gene and Pat of being the ringleaders.

programme.title: Appaloosa
programme.desc: Virgil Cole (Ed Harris) and his longtime friend and partner Everett Hitch (Viggo Mortensen) travel the 1880s Southwest, bringing justice to lawless towns desperate enough to hire them. In the mining town of Appaloosa, malevolent rancher Randall Bragg and his cronies ride roughshod over the frightened citizens. As Cole and Hitch work to end Bragg's reign of terror, an unconventional widow (Renee Zellweger) arrives, complicating the job and threatening their bond.

programme.title: Valdez Is Coming
programme.desc: When rancher Frank Tanner (Jon Cypher) hoodwinks local lawman Bob Valdez (Burt Lancaster) into shooting an innocent man, Valdez is remorseful and tries to take up a collection for the widow. Tanner won't hear of it, however, and punishes Valdez by driving him into the desert with a cross strapped to his back. Valdez is freed by one of Tanner's henchmen (Richard Jordan) and, after convalescing, begins waging a one-man war against Tanner, picking off his men with his trusty Sharps rifle.

programme.title: The Scalphunters
programme.desc: Illiterate fur trapper Joe Bass (Burt Lancaster) is coerced by some Kiowa Indians into trading his haul for a well-educated, escaped slave named Joseph Lee (Ossie Davis). Bass seeks to track the Indians and recover his treasure, while Joseph wants to travel to Mexico, where slavery is illegal. Their plans are complicated by the arrival of a band of scalphunters, led by Jim Howie (Telly Savalas), who want to kill the Indians, claim the furs and resell the black man.

programme.title: Vera Cruz
programme.desc: Following the American Civil War, veteran Benjamin Trane (Gary Cooper) and gunslinger Joe Erin (Burt Lancaster) are just two of many men who head to Mexico as mercenaries. When Emperor Maximillian (George Macready) recruits their services, they reluctantly work together, since the price is right. Trane and Erin are to escort Countess Marie Duvarre (Denise Darcel) to Vera Cruz -- but when they find a wealth of gold hidden in the stagecoach, the original plan no longer applies.

programme.title: Wild Rovers
programme.desc: Tired of his job at a ranch owned by Walter Buckman (Karl Malden), Frank Post (Ryan O'Neal) wants to pull a heist, and when his much older coworker, Ross Bodine (William Holden), sees nothing better on the horizon, the cowboys agree to team up for the crime. After filling their pockets with loot from a local bank, Frank and Ross ride toward what they hope is freedom. But the younger Buckmans, Paul (Joe Don Baker) and John (Tom Skerritt), pursue them over the rough land of the Southwest.

programme.title: Slock Master
programme.desc: The Slock Master reveals the tricks and tips that fool predators. Bowhunting coyotes, fox, lion, bobcat and more with incredible close up call ins and amazing archery action. Watch the world's top bow hunter slock em on The Slock Master.

programme.title: Modern Hunter
programme.desc: Follow retired firefighter Steve Heath as he embarks on the hunt of a lifetime deep in the heart of Texas. Steve was selected as a recipient of the annual Bucks for the Brave event, a special initiative by the non-profit organization.

programme.title: Maxed Outdoors
programme.desc: Max heads up to Stuttgart, Arkansas with family and friends. Their goal is to limit out on ducks on the last week of the season. They got on ducks and geese, all while battling rough weather.

programme.title: Deer and Deer Hunting
programme.desc: Whether you're hunting 10 acres or 1,000, how you handle boundaries, buck movement, and communication with neighboring hunters can make or break your season. The team shares real-world scenarios and proven strategies to foster cooperation.

programme.title: The Next Bite
programme.desc: Tommy Kemos and Austin Ragotzkie use an underutilized technique to catch fall Rock River walleyes in Wisconsin.
programme.sub-title: Jig Trolling for Fall River Walleyes

programme.title: University of Fishing
programme.desc: Charlie and Ben are joined by a host of veterans, including James Worldwide Watson as they help manage an amazing private lake.

programme.title: Fly Rod Chronicles
programme.desc: Curtis and his family travel to the world-renowned Casa Vieja Lodge in Guatemala to catch sailfish on the fly. Captain/Owner David Salazar and his crew put us on multiple sailfish a day and made sure this was a family tip of a lifetime.
programme.sub-title: Sailfish On The Fly in Guatemala Pt. 1

programme.title: Seasons on the Fly
programme.desc: Welcome to Alaska's Bearclaw Lodge in Bristol Bay. It's a full service lodge on the edge of the Wood Tikchik State Park, the largest State Park in the United States.

programme.title: The High Road With Keith Warren
programme.desc: On this episode of The High Road with Keith Warren, Keith and Johnny Piazza head out to G2 Ranch to use two totally different .50 calibers to hunt exotics. Johnny takes the massive 50 BMG and goes after a Scimitar Horned-Oryx with a long-range shot!
programme.sub-title: 50 Calibers VS Exotics at G2 Ranch

programme.title: Wiebe Trapline Adventures
programme.desc: For 23 years John has worked as a government trapper, wildlife biologist and district supervisor in the Federal Wildlife Services Program. Many of those years involved trapping year-round to resolve coyote and beaver damage to livestock.
programme.sub-title: John and Mark on Multi Line 1 of 2

programme.title: Innerloc's Outthere Stories
programme.desc: The most iconic deer stories we ever told. The hunt for ghost. Big Jesse Dunlap catches up to an Absolute Giant 8 point in Kansas.

programme.title: Shoot Straight TV
programme.desc: This week on Shoot Straight Chad has pronghorn tags for New Mexico and Wyoming. Marsha will be making a delicious Recipe from the Field.

programme.title: McWhorters Precision Hunting
programme.desc: Allan hunts Panther Hollow Whitetails in South Texas for a couple giant bucks.

programme.title: Deertopia
programme.desc: Steve explains the benefits of having less resources while figuring out the key to still maximizing your fun in the deer woods.

programme.title: Carnivore
programme.desc: A designer hired to create T-shirt designs for the FREQ, the world's only ultrasonic game caller, trades out her services for a hog hunt with dogs and knives, where chaos and adrenaline are off the scale.

programme.title: Hunting After Dark
programme.desc: Jason and Justin run around in a Texas cold front looking for varmints and hogs that are up and moving looking for a meal.
programme.sub-title: Pre and Post Corn Harvest Hunt

programme.title: Dean Partridge's Canadian Whitetail
programme.desc: Part one of Rochelles Multi-year hunt with her Excalibur crossbow for the Flyer buck.

programme.title: Live the Wild Life
programme.desc: Follow Gus as we take a look at hunting whitetail deer in the northeast USA.

programme.title: The Bassquatch Hunter Fish Out of Water
programme.desc: Kayak Fishing vs. Bus Driver Mike takes out Ebonie from the Toledo Public School system. Ebonie catches her very first fish and learns why fishing is so addictive. Then Mike learns to drive a bus and helps throw an appreciation party!

programme.title: Wallhanger Tv
programme.desc: A major storm brings cleanup work and a pause in deer season. Back in Kentucky, the struggle is real with tough hunts and injuries, while Cadyn gives it her all during an Alabama trip.

programme.title: Weird Hunts
programme.desc: Not necessarily a tree stand, but it is made of wood, Matt has the idea to hunt off of a scarecrow pole. Sitting in the middle of a food plot, Matt gets up close and personal with deer in this episode.

programme.title: The American Way
programme.desc: Mark Holliday hunts Indiana whitetail.
programme.sub-title: Better to be Lucky than Good

programme.title: Conquest 200 - Life on a Family Deer Farm
programme.desc: Step behind the scenes of a working whitetail deer farm to discover the real story behind hunting scents. In Farm Chores, Doug Roberts of Conquest Scents reveals the surprising truth about deer urine collection-how it's regulated.

programme.title: Surviving Mann
programme.desc: The fifth episode of Wild Shots Season 1 is here!

programme.title: Maxed Outdoors
programme.desc: Max heads up to Stuttgart, Arkansas with family and friends. Their goal is to limit out on ducks on the last week of the season. They got on ducks and geese, all while battling rough weather.

programme.title: Yamaha's Whitetail Diaries
programme.desc: It's hunting season in Texas and we have guests from Yamaha and Garmin join us at our deer camp to kick the season off right.

programme.title: For Love Or Likes
programme.desc: The animals start dropping and points start racking up as the girls get comfortable in front of the camera. A coyote puts on a show chasing an already shot doe and the biggest buck in For Love or Likes history.

programme.title: The Edge
programme.desc: Join host Joe Eppele on a thrilling trip to Haida Gwaii in pursuit of his first Sitka Blacktail deer. Enjoy family fun fishing and nonstop action on a hunt in the heart of Haida Gwaii with Sandspit Adventures.

programme.title: Doug Koenig's Championship Season
programme.desc: Join Shooting Pro Doug Koenig as he travels to West Texas in his pursuit for a Carmen Mountain Whitetail or a Texas Aoudad using the all-new Ruger SFAR chambered in 308 Winchester.

programme.title: On The Road
programme.desc: The guys are still hunting at Freedom Farms, Gary LeVox's ranch in Tennessee. On last week's episode, Craig Morgan had a bit of bad luck. Will he redeem himself this week? The birds are starting to gobble and the shells are starting to fly.

programme.title: Pursue The Wild
programme.desc: Join Kristy Titus on a true Western adventure-starting at home on her Wyoming ranch, where the season kicks off with archery elk and her string of mules. With her dad having drawn an early rifle antelope tag, plans shift from alpine timber.
programme.sub-title: High Country Elk to Desert Antelope ----- Western Hunting Traditions

programme.title: Target Rich Environment
programme.desc: The TRE crew drags the famous couch back to the field for dove season-this time, it's our turn to pull the trigger instead of guiding. When the barrels get hot the dove don't stand a chance. And when the sky fills with pigeons.

programme.title: Red Arrow Tv
programme.desc: Join Kip and his friends Terry, Steve, and Tucker in this rugged west Texas country for one of the coolest spot and stalk elk hunts ever.

programme.title: Saltwater Underground with Nick Honachefsky
programme.desc: Jersey Shipwrecks hold beastly blackfish as Nick hops aboard with three top blackfish captains to target trophy tautog using jigs and secret methods.

programme.title: George Poveromo's World of Saltwater Fishing
programme.desc: George Poveromo returns to Rhode Island to pursue trophy striped bass.
programme.sub-title: TROPHY STRIPED BASS ON THE JIG, Westerly, Rhode Island!

programme.title: Sportsman's Adventures With Captain Rick Murphy
programme.desc: Capts. Rick and Ridge Murphy get hooked up on kingfish in Fort Pierce, Fla., with Capt. Eric Davis.

programme.title: Chasin The Sun
programme.desc: Meredith McCord arrives in late spring and joins Capt. Justin Leake on the hunt for a fish she's never caught before. Lo and behold, it's a day fit for a king.

programme.title: Goliath Fishing
programme.desc: Captain James Marko features NFL legend Javon Kearse on an epic offshore fishing and golfing experience.

programme.title: Uncharted Waters with Peter Miller

programme.title: Exploring the Mayan World
programme.desc: Traveling to Izamal, the "yellow city" named after the Maya sky god; touring the city's history, including a walk through the Convent of St. Anthony of Padua; venturing to Chichen Itza; looking at the achievements of Maya architecture.

programme.title: Exploring the Mayan World
programme.desc: A trip to Valladolid and Ek' Balam, two places in the Yucatan; the first offers travelers a chance to see a traditional agave distillery and an all-female troop of competitive horseback riders; the second is the ruins of what was once a Maya capital.

programme.title: Exploring the Mayan World

programme.title: Exploring the Mayan World
programme.desc: Exploring the history and culture of Mayapan and its surrounding region; the destruction of sacred Maya codices during public acts of faith held by the Spanish friar Diego de Landa; sampling dishes of grilled pork and ground pumpkin seeds.

programme.title: Exploring the Mayan World
programme.desc: Discovering what makes Uxmal a marvel of Maya urban planning; Dr. Barnhart explores archeological features, including the Pyramid of the Dwarf, the Palace of the Governors and the Nunnery Quadrangle; exploring the Loltun Caves.

programme.title: Exploring the Mayan World
programme.desc: Looking at Kabah, where one will find over 200 faces of Chaac the rain god and a rare example of literate public art; visiting Becal, famous for producing some of the best jipijapas in the Yucatan; taking a trip to the Celestun biosphere.

programme.title: Exploring the Mayan World
programme.desc: Labna is an architectural wonder crowned by three buildings, which are the Palacio, the El Mirador pyramid and the Labna Arch; decoding the cultural messages in these famous works; traveling back to Merida.

programme.title: The Skulls III
programme.desc: In this sequel, beautiful and determined college student Taylor Brooks (Clare Kramer) is intent on joining the secret society known as the Skulls, despite its history of being an organization consisting solely of men. Although she encounters strong resistance, Taylor takes steps toward being accepted into their ranks, but her efforts are derailed when her boyfriend is found dead. Taylor is considered the prime suspect. Can she clear her name and track down the real murderer?

programme.title: The Skeleton Key
programme.desc: Caroline Ellis (Kate Hudson), a good-natured nurse living in New Orleans, quits her job at a hospice to work for Violet Devereaux (Gena Rowlands), an elderly woman whose husband, Ben (John Hurt), is in poor health following a stroke. When Caroline begins to explore the couple's rundown Bayou mansion, she discovers strange artifacts and learns the house has a mysterious past. As she continues to investigate, she realizes that Violet is keeping a sinister secret about the cause of Ben's illness.

programme.title: The Watcher
programme.desc: The Watcher is an exciting psychological thriller that takes a unique look into the minds of both a serial killer and the man who must, reluctantly, pursue him. In an almost Hitchcockian way, the film quickly introduces us to the killer, David Allen Griffin, played by Keanu Reeves, who for many years, preyed on lonely young women in the Los Angeles area. The story is set up to create a taut cat-and-mouse game between Griffin and FBI agent Joel Campbell.

programme.title: Boogeyman
programme.desc: Mike (Eddie McClintock), the town sheriff, has to battle the mythical Boogeyman after boys accidentally release it.

programme.title: My Little Eye
programme.desc: As part of an Internet reality show, five people sign up to spend six months in a mansion while cameras film constantly. If each person stays the entire length of the show, everyone walks away with $1 million -- a premise that seems too good to be true. Strange things start happening, like the arrival of mysterious, disturbing packages, filled with items like guns and morbid letters. After an unexpected death, the participants start to question the true reality of this experiment.

programme.title: The Skulls II
programme.desc: The Skulls, a secret college society whose influence reaches the highest levels of government and business, recruits Ryan Sommers (Robin Dunne), whose future success now seems all but assured. Then one day he sees one of his fraternity brothers kill a young woman -- a crime that Ryan must keep secret if he is to remain a Skull. While Kelly (Lindy Booth), a good friend, pushes him to follow his conscience, Ryan's girlfriend, Ali (Ashley Lyn Cafagna), surprises him by being against his snitching.

programme.title: Heartbeeps
programme.desc: While at the repair factory, Val (Andy Kaufman), a robot valet, meets Aqua (Bernadette Peters), a fellow automaton who functions as a party hostess. Remarkably, the two robots discover that they are in love, and impulsively flee from their duties. Looking for a place where they can establish a home, Val and Aqua create their own mechanized child, but their happiness is short-lived, since a relentless enforcer robot has been programmed to apprehend them.

programme.title: I, Frankenstein
programme.desc: Two centuries after Dr. Frankenstein assembles and reanimates his creature, Adam (Aaron Eckhart) is still living. It is up to Adam to discover his inner humanity and the reason for his continued existence.

programme.title: Drive Angry

In it, the two pursue the cult leader, who plans to sacrifice the infant and unleash hell on Earth. programme.desc: A former assassin, known simply as The Bride (Uma Thurman), wakes from a coma four years after her jealous ex-lover Bill (David Carradine) attempts to murder her on her wedding day. Fueled by an insatiable desire for revenge, she vows to get even with every person who contributed to the loss of her unborn child, her entire wedding party, and four years of her life. After devising a hit list, The Bride sets off on her quest, enduring unspeakable injury and unscrupulous enemies.

programme.title: Kill Bill: Vol. 2
programme.desc: The Bride (Uma Thurman) picks up where she left off in volume one with her quest to finish the hit list she has composed of all of the people who have wronged her, including ex-boyfriend Bill (David Carradine), who tried to have her killed four years ago during her wedding to another man. Leaving several dead in her wake, she eventually tracks down Bill in Mexico. Using skills she has learned during her assassin career, she attempts to finish what she set out to do in the first place.

programme.title: Inglourious Basterds
programme.desc: It is the first year of Germany's occupation of France. Allied officer Lt. Aldo Raine (Brad Pitt) assembles a team of Jewish soldiers to commit violent acts of retribution against the Nazis, including the taking of their scalps. He and his men join forces with Bridget von Hammersmark, a German actress and undercover agent, to bring down the leaders of the Third Reich. Their fates converge with theater owner Shosanna Dreyfus, who seeks to avenge the Nazis' execution of her family.

programme.title: The Hateful Eight
programme.desc: While racing toward the town of Red Rock in post-Civil War Wyoming, bounty hunter John "The Hangman" Ruth (Kurt Russell) and his fugitive prisoner (Jennifer Jason Leigh) encounter another bounty hunter (Samuel L. Jackson) and a man who claims to be a sheriff. Hoping to find shelter from a blizzard, the group travels to a stagecoach stopover located on a mountain pass. Greeted there by four strangers, the eight travelers soon learn that they may not make it to their destination after all.

programme.title: Divergent
programme.desc: Tris Prior (Shailene Woodley) lives in a futuristic world in which society is divided into five factions. As each person enters adulthood, he or she must choose a faction and commit to it for life. Tris chooses Dauntless -- those who pursue bravery above all else. However, her initiation leads to the discovery that she is a Divergent and will never be able to fit into just one faction. Warned that she must conceal her status, Tris uncovers a looming war which threatens everyone she loves.

programme.title: The Divergent Series: Insurgent
programme.desc: Now on the run from Jeanine (Kate Winslet) and the rest of the power-hungry Erudites, Tris (Shailene Woodley) and Four (Theo James) search for allies and answers in the ruins of Chicago. They must find out what Tris' family sacrificed their lives to protect and why the Erudites will do anything to stop them. Side by side, Tris and Four face one seemingly insurmountable challenge after another, as they unravel the secrets of the past and -- ultimately -- the future of their world.

programme.title: The Divergent Series: Allegiant
programme.desc: Tris (Shailene Woodley) escapes with Four (Theo James) to journey beyond the wall that encloses Chicago. For the first time, they leave the only city and family they have ever known to find a peaceful solution. Once outside, they learn shocking new truths that render old discoveries meaningless. As the ruthless battle threatens humanity, Tris and Four quickly decide who to trust to survive. Tris must ultimately make difficult choices about courage, allegiance, sacrifice and love.

programme.title: Manhunter
programme.desc: FBI criminal profiler Will Graham (William L. Petersen) is called out of early retirement to assist on a serial murder case involving a killer known as the "Tooth Fairy" (Tom Noonan). Graham enlists the help of imprisoned serial killer -- and cannibal -- Dr. Hannibal Lecktor (Brian Cox), who is the reason Graham took an early retirement. Soon, Graham and the FBI are entangled in a deadly cat-and-mouse game between the Tooth Fairy, Lecktor and an interfering journalist (Stephen Lang).

programme.title: Hannibal Rising
programme.desc: After witnessing the violent deaths of his parents at the end of World War II, young Hannibal Lecter (Gaspard Ulliel) flees to his uncle's home in Paris. He learns his uncle is dead, but the man's mysterious Japanese widow, Lady Murasaki (Gong Li) welcomes him nonetheless. An aptitude for science helps Hannibal gain acceptance to medical school, where he hones the skills he needs to exact revenge for the atrocities he witnessed.

programme.title: Frailty
programme.desc: Set in present day Texas, "Frailty" centers on the FBI's search for a serial killer who calls himself "God's Hands." McConaughey plays Fenton Meeks, a young man who approaches the lead investigator, one night, claiming he knows the identity of the killer. The FBI agent is curious, but unimpressed until Fenton reveals that the killer is his younger brother Adam. This is a film about faith, family and the end of innocence.

programme.title: Death Proof
programme.desc: Stuntman Mike (Kurt Russell) is a professional body double who likes to take unsuspecting women for deadly drives in his free time. He has doctored his car for maximum impact; when Mike purposely causes wrecks, the bodies pile up while he walks away with barely a scratch. The insane Mike may be in over his head, though, when he targets a tough group of female friends, including real-life stuntwoman Zoe Bell (who served as Uma Thurman's double in "Kill Bill"), who plays herself.

programme.title: Reservoir Dogs
programme.desc: A group of thieves assemble to pull of the perfect diamond heist. It turns into a bloody ambush when one of the men turns out to be a police informer. As the group begins to question each other's guilt, the heightening tensions threaten to explode the situation before the police step in.

programme.title: Jackie Brown
programme.desc: When flight attendant Jackie Brown (Pam Grier) is busted smuggling money for her arms dealer boss, Ordell Robbie (Samuel L. Jackson), agent Ray Nicolette (Michael Keaton) and detective Mark Dargus (Michael Bowen) want her help to bring down Robbie. Facing jail time for her silence or death for her cooperation, Brown decides instead to double-cross both parties and make off with the smuggled money. Meanwhile, she enlists the help of bondsman Max Cherry (Robert Forster), a man who loves her.

programme.title: Kill Bill: Vol. 1
programme.desc: A former assassin, known simply as The Bride (Uma Thurman), wakes from a coma four years after her jealous ex-lover Bill (David Carradine) attempts to murder her on her wedding day. Fueled by an insatiable desire for revenge, she vows to get even with every person who contributed to the loss of her unborn child, her entire wedding party, and four years of her life. After devising a hit list, The Bride sets off on her quest, enduring unspeakable injury and unscrupulous enemies.

programme.title: Kill Bill: Vol. 2
programme.desc: The Bride (Uma Thurman) picks up where she left off in volume one with her quest to finish the hit list she has composed of all of the people who have wronged her, including ex-boyfriend Bill (David Carradine), who tried to have her killed four years ago during her wedding to another man. Leaving several dead in her wake, she eventually tracks down Bill in Mexico. Using skills she has learned during her assassin career, she attempts to finish what she set out to do in the first place.
